text: Now the 12fps boil on the line work.

I built the "Crumb & Co" piece (6 s, 24 fps, cream background), but I only checked it on contact-sheet frames and didn't run the critique pass.

- **Line drawing:** The **stem** draws on from 0.4 s. Five wheat grains follow and fill in as each one draws. The **loaf** outline draws from 1.2 s to 2.8 s with its fill fading in. Three score marks cut across the top at 2.9–3.3 s.
- **Hand-drawn wobble:** Every line layer jitters in position and rotation in 12 fps steps, so it reads like hand-animated boil. The movement is subtle, so it won't show on the contact-sheet frames.
- **Blobs:** Four irregular blobs in honey, terracotta, sage and tan grow in softly. After that they breathe slowly, with scale and a little rotation drifting out of sync.
- **Name:** "Crumb & Co" pops in letter by letter with a gentle spring from 3.5 s and holds until the end.

Some details to know:
- The title font is set to Caveat. I didn't check whether it's installed here, and in the frames the title renders in a plain bold sans, so Caveat is probably falling back. If it is, change it to a handwritten font you have for the friendlier look.
- The title sits at the bottom, close to the wheat and loaf.
- I trimmed the stem and score marks' start times so no stray specks show before they draw.

I can make the wobble stronger, slow the draw-on, or add a small crumb-sprinkle or steam loop at the end if you want.
